Read by purpose: the Sheet screen is drawn only by maths/MathsTV.tsx, since screens.tsx no longer has one, and the file's own header calls it Math Buddy's marked sheet. keys.ts and store.ts still import it. (6) No group was added: 7 groups before and after. desk-subjects and desk-surfaces got new descriptions.
